pages.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Final in-game comic illustration for a mobile sci-fi toy-mecha game. Landscape 3:2 composition. A single page with TWO cinematic comic panels separated by one bold dark diagonal gutter, top/left panel about 60 percent and lower/right about 40 percent. Polished illustrated 3D toy aesthetic, clean confident outlines, subtle halftone shadows, cream-white navy cyan mechanical design, warm amber and coral dramatic accents. Detailed but readable on a 360px screen. Preserve the hero identity in the reference: cream armor, navy joints, cyan V visor, two cyan ear fins, tiny orange forehead accent, round cyan reactor. A city built of floating modular sci-fi districts in a sea of clouds. Full color opaque scene background. No text, letters, captions, speech balloons, numbers, logos, watermark, UI or typography anywhere; all words are added separately in the game. Exactly two clear dramatic panels; important subjects well inside frame with safe edge padding. Story beat: Before the lockdown: large upper panel is a breathtaking peaceful dawn panorama of the floating toy city, turquoise energy roads and bridges linking an orange factory, airborne transport docks, fortified corridor, violet power towers and distant gold central citadel, little civilian service robots moving peacefully. Smaller lower/right panel: purple energy lightning fractures a power tower and amber warning lights begin, the first hint of a citywide blackout. No hero character needed in this page.
